releases.notes:
First of all, we are deeply sorry that this update took almost 2 months to arrive! Thank you so much for your patience while we worked on getting everything tested and ready for the newest game versions. This update restores full compatibility and brings Infinite Villager Discounts back to life for Minecraft 26.1 through 26.2!

In previous versions, the mod loaded fine without throwing any errors, but the villager discount logic failed to apply in-game due to changes in newer Minecraft versions.

* **Mixin & Logic Fix:** Fixed the underlying mixin hooks and restored the infinite curing discount logic for villagers. * **Thoroughly Tested:** Extensive in-game testing was performed across all supported versions to guarantee that discount stacking, trade persistence, and relogs work flawlessly without issues. * **Expanded Game Support:** Fully updated and verified for Minecraft **26.1, 26.1.1, 26.1.2, and 26.2**. * **Zero Client Footprint:** Fully server-side compatible! Players can join your server without needing the mod installed on their client. * **High Performance:** Lightweight design with zero server lag or tick spikes.

releases.notes: Welcome to the first official release of **Infinite Villager Discounts**! * **Feature:** Restores the classic Minecraft trading mechanics by entirely removing the modern capping on curing discounts. * **Stacking:** You can now cure zombie villagers multiple times to stack your discounts all the way down to a single Emerald. * **Compatibility:** 100% server-side compatible. Clients do not need to install this mod to join your server.
